text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I-I can hear it! There's a pulsating energy surging within my body!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: No way! Could I be awakening to a brand-new power?! This is just like what happens in Princess Fighter!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Whoooaaa! I'm in the zone! I feel like I could bust a giant meteor into little pieces!
